brief: Three real page stills inside one camera layer. Beats: 0-1 s wide; 0.6-1.9 s cursor glides to Options while the camera punches in (2.2x); 1.9 s click + ripple; 2.3 s crossfade to plans while the camera re-targets Try this plan; 3.9 s click; 4.4 s crossfade to setup at 1.15x, 'Task completed' chip at 5.0 s; 6.6-7.6 s return to the wide home frame so 8 s equals 0 s.
